^2Laswell:^7 Alex and Farah will hold orbit for secondary clearance, while Bravo Six leads the assault force to locate the chemical agents, retrieve Hadir, and kill The Wolf.

subtitle_zd30tunnels/dx_vom_wolf_death_w: ^1Wolf:^7 You have come far, but what you seek is already gone.
^1Wolf:^7 You have come far, but what you seek is already gone.
^1Wolf:^7 And I am just a lowly freedom fighter.
^1Wolf:^7 And I am just a lowly freedom fighter.
^1Wolf:^7 There is no escape. This is the end.
^1Wolf:^7 Your brother needed help. He has big plans. Killing me will not stop him. Even I cannot stop him now. It is too late, Commander.
subtitle_zd30tunnels/dx_vom_wolf_monolog: ^1Wolf:^7 Brothers, I speak to you now, for the last time. A new path awaits me.
^1Wolf:^7 They say we are like "the mafia." This is like a joke to me.
^1Wolf:^7 The western world, they believe we are for sale.
^1Wolf:^7 This is not true, of course. The super-power is for sale.
^1Wolf:^7 We are merely the buyers. We take the weapons, and we keep them, forever.
^1Wolf:^7 But, we own them, they do not own us.
^1Wolf:^7 We will never be captive to foreign power.
^1Wolf:^7 Yes, there is a price to pay for this, and we are happy to pay- In blood.
^1Wolf:^7 Because shed blood in revenge, is always a victory.
^1Wolf:^7 This kind of group exists for only one reason only- to make money. They are thieves. Nothing more. It is a waste.
^1Wolf:^7 We plan attacks to show sadiq, 'truth.'
^1Wolf:^7 We are not killing in the dark and throwing the body into the ocean. We tell the world what we have done.

^1Wolf:^7 You know, where most of you come from... The doctor, the lawyer, the police, the army... All of these "very, very important people," they take an oath to protect something, but they do not have to prove it, they only have to say it.
^1Wolf:^7 But there is no oath to become a real warrior. You cannot tell me who you are, because I do not care what you say...
^1Wolf:^7 I only care what you do.
^1Wolf:^7 To die for what you believe, is easy.
^1Wolf:^7 To fight without sorrow, to wage war without sympathy... this is the only way to become a true soldier.
